blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Naga City Mayor Leni Robredo on Monday clarified that she has no intention of leaving the Catholic Church after a photo of her wearing Masonic regalia during a recent gathering circulated on social media, drawing questions about her faith. In a Facebook post, Robredo said she maintains good relations with non-Catholic churches and religious organizations in Naga City and appreciates the warmth with which they welcome her. She stressed that her responsibility as mayor is to serve residents regardless of their religious beliefs. “But let me be clear: I am a devout Catholic, and I have no intention […]...
